    },
    {
      "source": "farmington/final_permit.pdf",

      "exact_span": "TEST SPECIES AND METHODS           Daphnia pulex/ Method 2021.0 (EPA/821/R-\n                                           02-012 or latest version)\n                                    Pimephales promelas/ Method 2000.0 (EPA-\n                                           821-R-02-012 or latest version)",
      "affected_purpose": "B",
      "computation_change_reason": "Specifies required species and methods, including 'or latest version' qualifiers; different interpretations of method version applicability would change which monitoring requirements were in effect and whether reported results satisfy the obligation."
    },
    {
      "source": "farmington/final_permit.pdf",
      "locator": "Page: 13, Section: part_i",
      "exact_span": "Once initiated, all toxicity tests must be completed unless specific authority has been granted by EPA Region 6 or the State NPDES permitting authority.",
      "affected_purpose": "B,C",
      "computation_change_reason": "Conditions when incomplete WET testing is permissible; interpretation affects whether monitoring was required to continue through completion and whether partial or terminated tests should be treated as missing evidence, documented non-requirement, or unresolved."
    },
    {
      "source": "farmington/final_permit.pdf",
      "locator": "Page: 13, Section: part_i",
      "exact_span": "The permittee shall repeat a test, including the control and all effluent dilutions, if the procedures and quality assurance requirements defined in the test methods or in this permit are not satisfied, including the following additional criteria:",

  ]
}
